title: PR: 'Even Realities Unveils G1 Digital Glasses'
detail: Even Realities unveils G1 camera-free display glasses.

title: Even G2 (US$599) and R1 ring (US$249) available to order; 27.5° FOV, no cameras/speakers
detail: G2 and R1 smart ring available to order: HAO 2.0 optics, 27.5° FOV, 640x350, 1,200 nits, 2-day battery, IP67, no cameras or speakers; Even Hub developer platform 'later this year'.

title: Even G2 'Conversation Support Prep Notes' feature
detail: PR announcing the Conversation Support Prep Notes feature for G2.

title: Even Realities US$150m pre-Series B led by Meituan and Tencent at US$1bn valuation
detail: US$150m pre-Series B led by Meituan and Tencent; US$1bn valuation; proceeds for next-gen glasses platform, optics stack and in-house lens factory; users wear G2 8-10 h/day; >50% of users in US.

title: CEO Will Wang: G3 'will not launch in 2026'; cameras excluded from roadmap direction
detail: CEO says next-gen glasses will not launch in 2026, may not carry the G3 name, trade-in for G2 users considered; cameras excluded for battery/privacy reasons ('we're aiming in a different direction').

title: Even G2 software overhaul (Terminal Mode, AI Ques, Even AI, Even Hub) within 1-3 months
detail: Planned G2 software overhaul including Terminal Mode, AI Ques, Even AI and Even Hub within one to three months.
